    Questions

    How much is YouTube Premium Individual in the United States?+

    Individual costs $15.99 a month + tax in the United States. Other plans: Family $26.99 a month + tax; Student $8.99 a month + tax; Premium Lite $8.99 a month + tax.

    Do you get less in a cheaper country?+

    Usually not. The same plan has the same features and quality wherever it's sold. What can differ is the catalogue, because of regional licensing, and which plans are offered.

    Why might I see a different price than the one here?+

    Taxes, an introductory offer, paying in the iPhone app instead of on the website, or a recent price change. Prices in US dollars also move a little with the exchange rate, updated every week.
